integrity: No independent audit or external certification is claimed. Previously known bilinear orthogonality and finite-field quadratic-form results are credited; the new assertion is degree-sequence reconstruction within the specified family.
scientific_limitations: Standard graded commutative local Gorenstein algebras over finite fields with Hilbert vector \((1,d,1)\) and \(d\ge2\) only; does not cover general Artinian Gorenstein rings or ungraded coefficient rings. Computational tests are finite and do not replace proof. An independently identified historical equivalent remains possible.
title: Degree-sequence reconstruction of finite graded socle-degree-two Gorenstein rings
